an7.52:3.6: why is it that giving exactly the same gift is very fruitful and beneficial, sir?”
an7.52:7.1: Nor thinking, ‘It’s good to give,’ do they give a gift;
an7.52:8.1: Nor thinking, ‘Giving was practiced by my father and my father’s father. It would not be right for me to abandon this family custom,’ do they give a gift;
an7.52:9.1: Nor thinking, ‘I cook, they don’t. It wouldn’t be right for me to not give to them,’ do they give a gift;
an7.52:10.1: Nor thinking, ‘Just as the seers of the past performed those great sacrifices, namely—
an7.52:10.2: Aṭṭhaka, Vāmaka, Vāmadeva, Vessāmitta, Yamadaggi, Aṅgīrasa, Bhāradvāja, Vāseṭṭha, Kassapa, and Bhagu—just as they performed great sacrifices, I will share a gift,’ do they give a gift;
an7.52:12.2: not giving a gift with their mind tied to it,

an7.52:12.4: not giving a gift thinking, ‘I’ll enjoy this in my next life,’
